content.title: Christus Victor: An Historical Study of the Three Main Types of the Idea of the Atonement
content.author: Gustaf Aulén · translated by A. G. Hebert (London: SPCK, 1931)
content.note: The Swedish Lutheran theologian's lectures sorting atonement teaching into three types: the classic idea of Christ's victory over sin, death and the devil; the Latin idea of satisfaction offered to God; and the subjective idea of a change worked in us. He argues that the classic type was the New Testament's, the Fathers' and Luther's. In copyright: described in our own words, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
